The [[Stygian Defender]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[shield]] dropped by both the [[Stygian Lord (monk)|monk Stygian Lord]] and the [[Stygian Lord (elementalist)|elementalist Stygian Lord]], who can be found in [[Stygian Veil]]. It is currently not known if it can be dropped by the other two types of [[Stygian Lord]]s.

==Stats==
:[[Armor rating|Armor]]: 16 (Requires 9 [[Command]])
:Armor +10 (vs. [[Demon]]s)
:[[Health]] +30

This item cannot be replicated, as the +10 armor versus Demons is not an available [[inscription]]. The other (unique) versions of this shield are the:
